metadata.title: Configuration
metadata.description: This section allows administrators to define and manage system-wide settings that apply across the entire platform. These global parameters control core functionalities, security policies, performance thresholds, and other critical configurations.

admin_config.mineru_api_description: When enabled, the system will prioritize using the MinerU API for document parsing to improve parsing quality and speed.
admin_config.mineru_api_token_tips: Tips: The official MinerU API Token is valid for 14 days, please replace it before it expires.
admin_config.use_markitdown_description: When enabled, the system will use markitdown for document parsing.
admin_config.parser_health_description: Shows the current parser path, dependency readiness, external service reachability, and customer-facing support tiers.
admin_config.system_default_quota_description: These default quotas help maintain system stability, prevent resource abuse, and ensure fair allocation across users or applications.

metadata.title: User Management
metadata.description: This module enables administrators to centrally control and organize all system users with secure access configurations. Efficiently manage identities, permissions, and authentication policies across your organization.

metadata.title: ApeRAG
metadata.description: Production-Ready RAG Platform with Graph, Vector & Full-Text Search.

metadata.title: API keys
metadata.description: This section allows you to securely store, update, and manage API keys for different AI services (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.). Connecting your keys enables personalized AI interactions while keeping your credentials protected.

page_api_keys.masked_notice: Existing API keys are only shown in masked form. Create a new key if you need to copy it again.
page_api_keys.api_key_placeholder: Please describe the purpose of an Api Key.
page_api_keys.api_key_description: API keys must be kept confidential (e.g., stored in environment variables) to avoid exploitation or unexpected charges.
page_api_keys.created_api_key_title: Save your new API key now
page_api_keys.created_api_key_description: This API key will only be shown once. Store it somewhere secure before closing this dialog.
page_api_keys.created_api_key_hint: For security reasons, you won't be able to view this full key again after closing this dialog.
page_api_keys.delete_api_key_confirm: Confirm deletion of the API key?

metadata.title: Audit Logs
metadata.description: Track and review all critical system activities with Audit Logs—a detailed record of user actions, API calls, and administrative changes. Ensure transparency, security, and compliance by monitoring who did what, when, and from where.

metadata.title: Evaluation
metadata.description: Start evaluation from this collection by curating datasets, publishing runnable versions, and handing them off to bot runs.

page_benchmarks.hero_title: Start evaluation from the collection, not from chat.
page_benchmarks.hero_description: This page is the first stop for evaluation. Create a dataset, publish its first version, and then jump into a bot run with a version that is already ready to execute.
page_benchmarks.first_use_description: Keep the first run simple. Build one dataset, publish one version with a real case, then move to a bot's Evaluation page to start the run.
page_benchmarks.first_use_dataset_hint: Create the dataset here so the evaluation entry stays anchored in the collection context.
page_benchmarks.first_use_version_hint: Publish the first version immediately. A dataset without a published version still cannot be used for runs.
page_benchmarks.first_use_run_hint: Once a version is ready, open a bot's Evaluation page and start a run with that dataset version id.
page_benchmarks.datasets_section_description: Use datasets to define what this collection should be tested against. Each card keeps the latest runnable version visible, so you can publish quickly and move straight into a run.
page_benchmarks.empty_description: Create a dataset here, publish its first version, and then continue into a bot run. This page is the evaluation starting point for the collection.
page_benchmarks.create_dataset_description: Start with a small, real dataset. You can publish the first version right after this step.
page_benchmarks.dataset_description_placeholder: Describe what this dataset should validate and why it belongs to this collection.
page_benchmarks.create_dataset_missing_id: The backend created a dataset but did not return its id
page_benchmarks.create_dataset_success: Dataset created. Publish the first version next.
page_benchmarks.create_version_description: Add one real case so this dataset becomes runnable immediately.
page_benchmarks.create_version_description_named: Add one real case so {dataset} becomes runnable immediately.
page_benchmarks.create_version_helper: Keep the first version narrow. One representative case is enough to validate the flow end to end.
page_benchmarks.input_message_placeholder: Write the message that should be sent to the bot for this case.
page_benchmarks.expected_answer_placeholder: Optional. Capture the expected outcome for later judging.
page_benchmarks.reference_context_placeholder: Optional. Add any extra context or ground truth that should travel with this case.
page_benchmarks.create_version_input_required: Input message is required to publish a version
page_benchmarks.create_version_missing_id: The backend published a version but did not return its id
page_benchmarks.created_version_description: {dataset} now has a runnable version: {version}. The next step is to choose the target bot explicitly and start the run from that bot's Evaluation page.
page_benchmarks.choose_bot_hint: Do not rely on a default bot here. Open the target bot's Evaluation page explicitly, then paste this dataset version id to start the run.
page_benchmarks.error_title: Benchmark data could not be loaded
page_benchmarks.error_description: The benchmark endpoint returned an error. Please retry after the backend contract and server state are checked.
page_benchmarks.not_available_title: Benchmark APIs are not ready yet
page_benchmarks.not_available_description: The frontend route is in place. Data will populate here once the evaluation v2 backend endpoints land.

metadata.title: Applications
metadata.description: ApeRAG is a new chatbot based on local datasets and utilizes multiple large language models.

page_bot.delete_bot_confirm: Deleting the application will remove all sessions under this app. Please confirm the operation!
page_bot.title: Title
page_bot.description_placeholder: Please briefly introduce the purpose of the application.
page_bot.model_description: Setting the default model will serve as the default model for all new sessions.
page_bot.system_prompt_template_description: System Prompt defines the AI's role and behavioral rules, setting the overall context for the interaction.
page_bot.query_prompt_template_description: Query Prompt represents the user's specific input or question, which the AI processes and responds to within the framework set by the System Prompt.

metadata.title: Evaluation
metadata.description: Use this bot page to start and manage runs after a published dataset version already exists.

page_bot_evaluation.hero_title: Runs live here. The evaluation entry does not.
page_bot_evaluation.hero_description: This page is the run view for one bot. Bring a published dataset version from Collection > Evaluation, start the run here, then inspect progress and item-level traces.
page_bot_evaluation.step_create_run: Create a run for this bot
page_bot_evaluation.runs_scope_description: Keep creation lightweight here: choose a published dataset version and launch the run.
page_bot_evaluation.runs_scope_helper: Use this page to operate runs for the current bot. Dataset creation still starts from the collection side.
page_bot_evaluation.runs_panel_description: Track what this bot has already run, then drill into progress, items, retries, and traces.
page_bot_evaluation.runs_section_description: Every run on this page belongs to the current bot. Start new runs with a published dataset version, then use run detail to inspect execution and recover failed items.
page_bot_evaluation.items_description: Each item reflects one benchmark case and its latest execution attempt.
page_bot_evaluation.search_placeholder: Search runs, cases, or trace ids
page_bot_evaluation.empty_description: Bring a published dataset version from Collection > Evaluation, then start the first run for this bot here.
page_bot_evaluation.create_run_description: Launch a run for this bot with one published dataset version. Keep the first run small so the whole path is easy to validate.
page_bot_evaluation.create_run_helper: Need a dataset version id first? Start in Collection > Evaluation, create a dataset, publish the first version, then come back here.
page_bot_evaluation.empty_detail_title: Run details are not available yet
page_bot_evaluation.empty_detail_description: The run detail endpoint is reachable, but this run has not returned structured data yet.
page_bot_evaluation.empty_items_description: Items will appear after the run is created and the worker starts dispatching attempts.
page_bot_evaluation.error_title: Evaluation data could not be loaded
page_bot_evaluation.error_description: The evaluation endpoint returned an error. Please retry after the backend contract and server state are checked.
page_bot_evaluation.not_available_title: Evaluation APIs are not ready yet
page_bot_evaluation.not_available_description: The UI is ready. Data and actions will appear here once the evaluation v2 endpoints are merged.

page_chat.rag_description: ApeRAG is a production-ready RAG platform that combines graph, vector, and full-text search for hybrid retrieval, knowledge management, and enterprise AI applications.

metadata.title: Add collection
metadata.description: By importing and systematically organizing your data sources into a structured dataset, you can significantly improve the contextual understanding and response accuracy of large language models (LLMs)

metadata.title: Collections
metadata.description: By importing and systematically organizing your data sources into a structured dataset, you can significantly improve the contextual understanding and response accuracy of large language models (LLMs)

page_collections.delete_collection_confirm: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete collection and remove your documents from our servers.
page_collections.publish_collection_description: Allow users to discover and subscribe to your collection.
page_collections.unpublish_collection_description: Remove the collection from the marketplace, making it private.
page_collections.name: Name
page_collections.description_placeholder: Please describe the general meaning of a collection.
page_collections.index_types_description: Select the AI capabilities you need, we will build corresponding indexes for your documents

index_type_VECTOR.title: Vector
index_type_VECTOR.description: Represents data (text, images, etc.) as high-dimensional vectors to enable similarity-based retrieval.

index_type_FULLTEXT.title: Fulltext
index_type_FULLTEXT.description: Indexes keywords within text using techniques like inverted indexing for exact or fuzzy

index_type_GRAPH.title: Graph
index_type_GRAPH.description: Stores data as nodes (entities) and edges (relationships), enabling complex relational

index_type_SUMMARY.title: Summary
index_type_SUMMARY.description: Indexes summaries or metadata of long documents instead of raw content for faster

index_type_VISION.title: Vision
index_type_VISION.description: Encodes visual content (images/videos) into feature vectors for content-based retrieval.

page_collections.model_settings_description: Select AI models for document processing. Different index types require different model support
page_collections.embedding_model_description: An embedding model translates data into numerical vectors that capture their semantic meaning and relationships.
page_collections.completion_model_description: A completion model is an AI that generates new content by predicting the most likely subsequent text based on a given input.
page_collections.export_knowledge_base_confirm_content: This will package all contents of this knowledge base from object storage, including original files, parsed artifacts, chunk data, and images.
page_collections.export_knowledge_base_completed_descript: File size: {size}. The file will be automatically deleted after 7 days.
page_collections.export_knowledge_base_failed_description: An error occurred during export. Please try again.
page_collections.export_knowledge_base_too_many_tasks: An export task is already in progress. Please wait for it to complete.
page_collections.export_knowledge_base_link_expired: The export link has expired. Please export again.

metadata.title: Marketplace
metadata.description: Discover and subscribe to quality knowledge collections shared by community, expand your knowledge boundaries

metadata.provider_description: This section allows you to connect and customize your preferred Large Language Model (LLM) providers and models for personal use. Set up API keys, choose models, and adjust settings to enhance your AI experience.
metadata.model_description: This section allows you to connect and customize your preferred Large Language Model (LLM) providers and models for personal use. Set up API keys, choose models, and adjust settings to enhance your AI experience.

provider.name: Name
provider.base_url_description: The LLM API baseUrl refers to the root endpoint URL used to access a Large Language Model (LLM) API service.
provider.api_dialect_description: Completion API Dialect suggests possible outputs, Embedding API Dialect converts them to vectors, and Rerank API Dialect optimizes their order based on semantic relevance.
provider.api_key_placeholder: Please enter the api key for the model provider.
provider.api_key_description: To access the AI model's capabilities, you need to provide a valid API Key from your chosen model provider. This key serves as a secure authentication method, allowing the system to process your requests while maintaining privacy and usage control.
provider.delete_confirm: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete provider and remove your data from our servers.
provider.publish_confirm: Confirm publishing this provider to public? This action is irreversible and the provider will be visible to all admins.

default_model.help: Clearing selection will delete the default model configuration for this scenario

metadata.title: Prompt Management
metadata.description: Customize system prompts to adjust the AI assistant's behavior and conversation style. Changes override system defaults and can be reset at any time.

agent_system.title: System Prompt
agent_system.description: Defines the AI assistant's persona, role, and behavioral guidelines. Affects the base behavior across all conversations.

agent_query.title: Query Prompt
agent_query.description: The query template for each conversation. Controls how user questions and knowledge base context are combined before being sent to the AI.

action.reset_confirm: Reset this prompt to system default?
action.reset_confirm_description: This will delete your customization and restore the built-in system default prompt.

page_question_set.delete_question_set_confirm: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete question set and remove your question set from our servers.
page_question_set.delete_question_confirm: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete question.
page_question_set.prompt_template_tips: The following variables will be replaced by the system:
page_question_set.prompt_template_document_content: The content of the document from the collection.
page_question_set.prompt_template_number_of_question: The number of questions to be generated.

metadata.title: Quotas
metadata.description: Manage your usage limits for AI models, API calls, and other resources in this section. Quotas help you control costs, prevent overuse, and optimize your experience.

bot_count.title: Bot Count
bot_count.description: The upper limit for active bots in a system, preventing resource overuse and ensuring stability.

collection_count.title: Collection Count
collection_count.description: The maximum allowed collections in a database, controlling data structure complexity.

document_count.title: Documents Overall
document_count.description: Caps the total documents across all collections, managing overall storage capacity.

documents_per_collection.title: Documents per Collection
documents_per_collection.description: Limits documents per collection, optimizing query performance and data balance.

page_search.delete_confirm: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete search result.
